issues.issue: This utility-fund 'Other' line is assumed to be utility charges. If that's right, the user's own category is 'Utility Charges' (utility fund collections, incl. garbage), not charges for services/fees. If not, it stays an unexplained 'other'. It has review and decision_needed entries, but the category is a judgement call.

An unexplained 'Other' local receipt makes up 55% of governmental receipts (361,384.88 excluding transfers), and the report gives no breakdown. There's no decision_needed entry asking what it is (e.g. reimbursements, loan proceeds or fees).
